'''''Thoret''''' was a group of [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|''Delta''-class JV-7 escort shuttles]] affiliated with [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].

Deployed from the [[container transport]] [[Thor (container transport)|''Thor'']], the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] carried [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] for the idle [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]] of [[Baker group|Baker]] and [[Charly]] [[Flight group/Legends|group]] parked at a staging area. An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] raid on this area was one of the early uses of the [[Missile Boat]].

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Imperial pilot [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] participated in an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] combat [[Flight simulator/Legends|simulation]] of this raid.
